But for every drop of blood you spill, a million sentients will rise in rebellion.''"<br />"''Then I will spill a million buckets of blood.|[[Erling Tredway]] and Sebastian Parnell|<ref name="Jedi's Honor">''[[Jedi's Honor]]''</ref>}}
'''Sebastian Parnell''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|general]] who served as [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Sil'Lume system/Legends|Sil'Lume system]] during the time of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. He was distinguishable with his silver hair and ice-blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].

As governor, it was his personal task to bring the miners and prospectors of the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]] under Imperial control, while also overseeing the prisoners on [[Tol Ado]], the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].
